description: This file contains the implementation of the MemoryStreamBufferWriter struct which implements IBufferWriter<byte> to write data into a MemoryStream. It provides methods to get memory or span buffers and advance the stream position.

classes.name: MemoryStreamBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> that writes to a MemoryStream object, managing buffer growth and position.

methods.name: MemoryStreamBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer writer with a given MemoryStream.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Offsets the current position in the stream by the specified count.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> segment with at least sizeHint capacity, resizing the stream buffer if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> segment with at least sizeHint capacity, resizing the stream buffer if necessary.
